description: A stress response adapts to a known bad outcome. It does not adapt to an unresolved one, because there is nothing to adapt to. This is why 'no answer' is harder than 'no'.
energy_note: The one state the mind cannot settle into.

aspect: It prevents both planning and acceptance
description: A refusal permits a new plan. A pending file permits neither continuing nor abandoning, so the person holds two incompatible futures open indefinitely.
energy_note: Can't move on, can't move forward.

aspect: Hope, kept at full strength, is the injury
description: The permit might come. The name might be on the next list. The bridge might reopen. Hope is functional and it is also what keeps the wound from closing.
energy_note: Hoping, continuously, as a form of damage.

description: It has her name, her mother's medical file, four rejected applications and one unanswered one. She has carried it to six offices. She knows exactly which page each of them will ask for.
energy_note: A life, in a plastic wallet, at a window.
